title: P1: DecodedPart does not expose whole-file CRC32
description: yencoding::decode() parses =yend crc32= (whole-file CRC) but silently drops it. DecodedPart has no field for it. yencoding-multi docs imply callers can retrieve it for set_expected_crc32(), but they cannot. Fix: add pub whole_file_crc32: Option<u32> to DecodedPart, populate from yend.crc32 in finish_decode().
